title: Coding assistant on your own repo
sub: Propose, test and load a skill in a loop; a code-side check gates the branch it opens.

nodes.l: Check the diff and commands are in scope

steps.d:
"parse_duration() raises on '1h30m'; add a test
and fix it."

steps.h: Your code returns the skill body
steps.d:
"New tests for src/x go in tests/test_x.py,
one function per case, named test_<behavior>."

steps.h: The agent proposes an edit and runs the tests
Your code returns the test result
steps.d:
3 of 4 cases pass. '1h30m' still raises: the new
branch was never reached.
→ propose_edit(fix the branch order in parse_duration)

steps.h: Your code returns the test result
steps.d: 4 of 4 cases pass, including the new one.

steps.h: The agent asks to open a branch
steps.d:
diff: src/x.py, tests/test_x.py,
  .github/workflows/ci.yml (bumped the Python version)

steps.h: The check refuses part of the request
steps.d:
".github/workflows/ci.yml is outside this issue's scope.
Drop it and ask again with only the fix and its test."

steps.h: The agent asks again, in scope

steps.d:
Both paths match the issue. Branch fix/parse-duration-1h30m
opened for review.
